source_note: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5, Release 5.2.0 identifiers and titles were checked against the NIST controls download catalog (https://csrc.nist.gov/Projects/risk-management/sp800-53-controls/downloads). ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A identifiers and short titles were checked against the ANSI National Accreditation Board 2013-to-2022 annex comparison (https://blog.ansi.org/anab/iso-iec-27001-2013-2022-comparison/). The same title words appear in the contents of BS EN ISO/IEC 27002:2022 (https://webstore.ansi.org/preview-pages/BSI/preview_30465419.pdf) and DS/ISO/IEC 27002:2022 (https://webstore.ansi.org/preview-pages/DS/preview_M362244CURES.pdf). The free ISO/IEC 27001:2022 preview names Annex A and does not list each control title. ISO/IEC 42001:2023 is identified by the ISO preview (https://webstore.ansi.org/preview-pages/ISO/preview_ISO%2BIEC%2B42001-2023.pdf), which names Annex A and does not list each control title. The four stored ISO/IEC 42001 short titles match the Sensiba readiness checklist (https://explore.sensiba.com/hubfs/White%20Papers/RAS%20WP/WP%20-%20RAS%20-%20ISO%2042001%20Readiness%20Guide.pdf), the Modulos annex list (https://docs.modulos.ai/frameworks/iso-42001/annexes-a-d), and the OG Technologies control list (https://www.ogtechnologies.co/downloads/iso-42001-annex-a-controls.pdf). No control statement text is stored. Applicability and rationale are project mapping decisions and remain draft. ISO entries are draft portfolio review prompts, not conformity, certification, or equivalence findings.

mappings.title: Least Privilege
mappings.applicability_note: Relevant when a vendor integration receives access to organizational systems or information.
mappings.rationale: Use as a review prompt for whether vendor permissions are limited to the access needed for the service. This mapping does not assess implementation or effectiveness.

mappings.title: Event Logging
mappings.applicability_note: Relevant when the service processes organizational information or performs actions whose activity needs to be reviewed.
mappings.rationale: Use as a prompt to ask what security-relevant activity is logged and how the customer can obtain or review it. The mapping is not evidence that logging exists.

mappings.title: Identification and Authentication (Organizational Users)
mappings.applicability_note: Relevant when organizational users authenticate to the vendor service.
mappings.rationale: Use as a prompt to review how organizational users are identified and authenticated, including the authentication claims and related evidence provided for the service.

mappings.title: Transmission Confidentiality and Integrity
mappings.applicability_note: Relevant when information is transmitted to, from, or through the vendor service.
mappings.rationale: Use as a prompt to review protections for information in transit. The mapping does not establish that a particular protection is implemented or sufficient.

mappings.title: Access control
mappings.applicability_note: Shown because the claim topic is integration_permissions. Relevant when a vendor integration receives access to organizational systems or information.
mappings.rationale: Draft portfolio review prompt for whether access is limited to what the service needs. Checking the identifier and short title does not assess implementation. This entry is not a conformity or certification result.

mappings.title: Secure authentication
mappings.applicability_note: Shown because the claim topic is authentication. Relevant when organizational users authenticate to the vendor service.
mappings.rationale: Draft portfolio review prompt for how organizational users authenticate to the service. Checking the identifier and short title does not assess implementation. This entry is not a conformity or certification result.

mappings.title: Information transfer
mappings.applicability_note: Shown because the claim topic is transmission_security. Relevant when information is transferred to, from, or through the vendor service.
mappings.rationale: Draft portfolio review prompt for safeguards when information moves to, from, or through the service. Checking the identifier and short title does not assess implementation. This entry is not a conformity or certification result.

mappings.title: Logging
mappings.applicability_note: Shown because the claim topic is audit_logging. Relevant when the service processes organizational information or performs actions whose activity needs to be reviewed.
mappings.rationale: Draft portfolio review prompt to ask what security-relevant activity is logged and how it can be reviewed. Checking the identifier and short title does not assess implementation. This entry is not a conformity or certification result.

mappings.title: AI system operation and monitoring
mappings.applicability_note: Shown because the claim topic is audit_logging. Use this prompt when the service uses AI. The mapper does not read the AI-use answer, so a reviewer decides whether the prompt applies.
mappings.rationale: Draft portfolio review prompt to ask how an AI system is operated and monitored. A logging claim is not evidence that this control is implemented. This entry is not a conformity or certification result.

mappings.title: AI system recording of event logs
mappings.applicability_note: Shown because the claim topic is audit_logging. Use this prompt when the service uses AI. The mapper does not read the AI-use answer, so a reviewer decides whether the prompt applies.
mappings.rationale: Draft portfolio review prompt to ask what event logs an AI system keeps of its own activity. A logging claim is not evidence that this control is implemented. This entry is not a conformity or certification result.

mappings.title: Data for development and enhancement of AI system
mappings.applicability_note: Shown because the claim topic is privacy. Use it to ask whether customer data is used to develop or enhance an AI system. The mapper does not read the model-training answer.
mappings.rationale: Draft portfolio review prompt on the privacy claim, which is the tagged statement about collection, use, and retention of customer data. A privacy notice is not evidence that this control is implemented. This entry is not a conformity or certification result.

mappings.title: Acquisition of data
mappings.applicability_note: Shown because the claim topic is privacy. Use it to ask how data for an AI system was acquired. The privacy claim records the cited notice. It is not a completed control assessment.
mappings.rationale: Draft portfolio review prompt on the privacy claim. A privacy notice is not evidence that this control is implemented. This entry is not a conformity or certification result.
